stream_failure_boundaries.inner_stream_retries: retried inside streaming worker up to HERMES_STREAM_RETRIES (default 2 retries, 3 attempts)
stream_failure_boundaries.main_loop_reception: caught in except Exception as api_error; classified by classify_api_error
stream_failure_boundaries.recovery_dispatch: enters standard classified failover ladder (rate limit, transport 2-retry threshold, server error, fallback)
stream_failure_boundaries.worker_exhausted: raises result['error'] directly up to conversation_loop.py

stream_failure_boundaries.action:
silent retry inside streaming worker; emits '

⚠ Connection dropped mid tool-call; reconnecting…

' delta
stream_failure_boundaries.error_nature: transient (timeout, connection drop, sse connection closed)
stream_failure_boundaries.tracking_reset: calls _reset_stream_delivery_tracking(), clears partial_tool_names, continues streaming loop

stream_failure_boundaries.action: does NOT re-raise to outer loop; returns partial stream stub with finish_reason='length'
stream_failure_boundaries.recovery_dispatch: appends partial text, sends continuation nudge to prompt completion

stream_failure_boundaries.error_nature: classified as FailoverReason.content_policy_blocked (e.g. MiniMax new_sensitive, Azure content_filter)
stream_failure_boundaries.fallback_available_action: rolls back partial messages to last clean assistant turn; activates fallback provider; resets retry_count = 0
stream_failure_boundaries.no_fallback_action: emits '⚠️ No fallback provider configured -- retrying with same provider (may re-hit filter)...'; falls through to length continuation
stream_failure_boundaries.stub_tagging: _stub._content_filter_terminated is set to True on partial stub

ladder_contract.attempt_1: same-provider retry with jittered backoff (retry_count becomes 1; fallback gated by retry_count >= 2)
ladder_contract.attempt_2: FALLBACK ACTIVATES immediately if fallback provider is available (retry_count >= 2); retry_count resets to 0
ladder_contract.attempt_3: if NO fallback available: primary transport recovery attempted if direct endpoint; if that fails, terminal failure

ladder_contract.attempt_2: same-provider retry with jittered backoff (server_error not in _is_transport_failure)
ladder_contract.attempt_3: MAX RETRIES EXHAUSTED: fallback activates at retry_count >= max_retries; resets retry_count to 0
MAX RETRIES EXHAUSTED: fallback activates at retry_count >= max_retries; resets retry_count to 0

ladder_contract.attempt_1: EAGER FALLBACK ACTIVATES immediately if fallback available; resets retry_count to 0
ladder_contract.attempt_2: if NO fallback: same-provider retry with 5s-120s backoff
ladder_contract.attempt_3: if NO fallback: max retries invalid response terminal giving up
ladder_contract.terminal_no_fallback: ❌ Max retries (3) exceeded for invalid responses. Giving up.

turn_retry_state_contract.description: Each recovery branch checks `not _retry.<guard>` before executing and sets it to True so it runs at most once per turn attempt.
